assessment: This important study makes a solid connection between chromatin remodeling, post-translational regulation, and antifungal drug resistance in Cryptococcus neoformans, revealing a new facet of how drug resistance can emerge. Establishing a link between chromatin remodeling and antifungal resistance is a finding that will be of interest to infectious disease researchers, cell biologists, and drug developers.
